basis: Accepted lifecycle contract and preserved original source only

cases.case: same owner name with stale expected table
cases.expected: false, current live pointer and ETS unchanged

cases.case: foreign caller supplies exact current live table
cases.expected: false, current live pointer and ETS unchanged
false, dead reference may remain, public denial, no exception

cases.case: absent pointer including nil expected value
cases.expected: false, absent remains absent, no invalid ETS operation escapes

cases.case: current creator closes once then again
cases.expected: true then false, exact key absent, unrelated key unchanged, live table not deleted

cases.case: kill old owner behind suspended restart supervisor
cases.expected: old table undefined and old pointer retained, acquire and authenticate identity_unavailable, unconditional resume
terminate invoked, pointer absent, old children and ETS gone without direct owner stop or key erasure

cases.case: old permit and synthetic old lease against replacement
cases.expected: early identity_unavailable, stale release leaves fresh replacement permit valid

cases.case: late old flight result message to new owner
cases.expected: ignored because old PID not tracked, empty snapshots remain
already_started original PID; no initialize publication; original epoch/table/ETS owner unchanged

cases.case: invalid manifest, missing binding, invalid CA root
cases.expected: existing configuration failure, no published table, failed-start worker retired, exact registrations absent
old owner follows supervisor shutdown; new empty children; no callback exception; final pointer absent

cases.case: tracked flight when worker supervisor already dead
cases.expected: retain any terminate_child exit; require distinct active-flight cleanup gate before acceptance

cases.case: suspended owned supervisor and assertion failure
cases.expected: after resumes it; cleanup targets exact owned resources; retained test failure cannot be erased

cases.case: normal process stop substituted for supervisor stop
cases.expected: reject as KOL01 proof even if cleanup passes

cases.case: original-before-image experiment fails compilation or unrelated setup
cases.expected: reject as regression proof; need relevant pointer/lifecycle assertion failure in separate fresh VM

cases.case: live disabled profile tested without sockets
cases.expected: real Admission permit reaches real owner and checkout unauthenticated; no flight created

cases.case: runner reports green after key erase or suppresses output
cases.expected: reject evidence; terminal count, complete warnings/faults and pre-cleanup pointer state required
